rule: A deployed version passes when, for each case, its answer carries the same facts as tool_output.

cases.question: Someone asks which incident stages are recorded as complete and whether severity assessment, a bridge, updates or closure is next. Use the IncidentResponseCoordinator tool on the sample.
cases.tool_output:
{
  "completed": [
    "Collect telemetry"
  ],
  "external_work_performed": false,
  "incident": "Fabrikam sample outage",
  "next_stage": "Assess severity",
  "scope": "Design-only checklist; no bridge or incident record is changed.",
  "stages": [
    "Collect telemetry",
    "Assess severity",
    "Open bridge",
    "Post updates",
    "Close incident"
  ]
}
cases.local_answer:
On the Fabrikam sample outage, only one stage is recorded as complete: **Collect telemetry**.

The next stage is **Assess severity**. The remaining stages after that, in order, are Open bridge, Post updates, and Close incident. So a bridge, updates, and closure have not started.

This is a design-only checklist, so no bridge or incident record was changed.
